body.en: On ACT II Math Level 2: (1) An ellipse \( \frac{(x-h)^2}{a^2} + \frac{(y-k)^2}{b^2} = 1 \) (\( a > b \)) has focal distance \( c = \sqrt{a^2 - b^2} \) and eccentricity \( e = \frac{c}{a} < 1 \), while a hyperbola has \( c = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} \) and \( e > 1 \); (2) A sphere in \( \mathbb{R}^3 \) with center \( (x_0, y_0, z_0) \) and radius \( R \) has equation \( (x - x_0)^2 + (y - y_0)^2 + (z - z_0)^2 = R^2 \).
body.ar: On ACT II Math Level 2: (1) An ellipse \( \frac{(x-h)^2}{a^2} + \frac{(y-k)^2}{b^2} = 1 \) (\( a > b \)) has focal distance \( c = \sqrt{a^2 - b^2} \) and eccentricity \( e = \frac{c}{a} < 1 \), while a hyperbola has \( c = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} \) and \( e > 1 \); (2) A sphere in \( \mathbb{R}^3 \) with center \( (x_0, y_0, z_0) \) and radius \( R \) has equation \( (x - x_0)^2 + (y - y_0)^2 + (z - z_0)^2 = R^2 \).

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Conic Sections, 3D Coordinate Geometry, Combinatorics & Probability)
label.ar: ◆ البرهان والاشتقاق الرياضي (القطوع المخروطية والهندسة ثلاثية الأبعاد والتوافيق والاحتمالات (ACT II L2))

body.en: First-Principles Justification: Completing the square on \( ax^2 + bx + c \) gives \( a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \), which simultaneously establishes the vertex coordinates, discriminant condition \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac \), and quadratic root formula.
body.ar: البرهان الجبري: بإكمال المربع للمقدار \(ax^2 + bx + c\) نحصل على صيغة الرأس والمميز \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\) بدقة تامة.

body.en:
Problem: Express \( f(x) = x^2 - 18x + 89 \) in completed-square vertex form and find its minimum value.

Solution: Halving \( -18 \) gives \( -9 \), so \( f(x) = (x - 9)^2 - 81 + 89 = (x - 9)^2 + 8 \). Minimum value is \( 8 \) at \( x = 9 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد صيغة إكمال المربع للدالة \( f(x) = x^2 - 18x + 89 \).

الحل: \( f(x) = (x - 9)^2 + 8 \) والقيمة الصغرى هي \( 8 \) عند \( x = 9 \).

body.en:
Problem: Find the value of \( k \) for which \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to \( y = x^2 - 18x + 86 \).

Solution: Equating gives \( x^2 - 20x + (86 - k) = 0 \). Setting \( \Delta = (-20)^2 - 4(86 - k) = 0 \) yields \( k = -14 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد قيمة \( k \) التي تجعل المستقيم \( y = 2x + k \) مماساً للمنحنى \( y = x^2 - 18x + 86 \).

الحل: بوضع المميز \( \Delta = 0 \) نجد \( k = -14 \).

label.en: Worked Example 8.C — Rate of Change & Tangent Slope
label.ar: مثال محلول 8.C — معدل التغير وميل المماس

body.en:
Problem: Find the instantaneous rate of change of \( g(x) = x^3 - 27x^2 + 243x + 8 \) at \( x = 11 \).

Solution: \( g'(x) = 3(x - 9)^2 \), so \( g'(11) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد معدل التغير اللحظي للدالة \( g(x) = x^3 - 27x^2 + 243x + 8 \) عند \( x = 11 \).

الحل: \( g'(11) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
